facts.claim: Mehmadabad Town is the headquarters of its taluka in Kaira District, Bombay.
facts.quote: Mehmadabad Town ( Mahmudabdd ). — Head-quarters of the taluka of the same name in Kaira District, Bombay, situated in 220 50' N. and 720 46' E., on the Bombay, Baroda, and Central India Railway, 17 miles south of Ahmadabad.

facts.claim: The town had an average income of Rs. 9,500 during the decade ending 1901, rising to Rs. 9,600 in 1903-4.
facts.quote: Mehmadabad has been a municipality since 1863, with an average income of Rs. 9,500 during the decade ending 1901. In 1903-4 the income was Rs. 9,600.

facts.claim: The town contains a dispensary and four schools, including an English middle school with 57 pupils for boys and a girls' school with 102 pupils.
facts.quote: The town contains a dispensary and four schools, three (including an English middle school with 57 pupils) for boys and one for girls, attended by 427 and 102 pupils respectively.
